      "value_json": "{\"condition\": \"Where a record is retained for not less than seven years from the date of the invoice to which it relates, the Parties shall each act reasonably and without undue delay in giving effect to it, and neither Party shall unreasonably withhold any consent required in connection with it.\"}"

      "uncertainty": null,
